'''Watch Commander''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Gingal]] was the Watch [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the Alliance's [[Xyquine base|base]] at [[Xyquine II]] during the [[Battle of Xyquine II]].
